selection.selection_rule: random within each model ? task cell before observing LENGTH_MATCHED_ACK results; target 10 per cell
selection.primary_analysis_rule: Completed trajectory with at least one non-final assistant slot, fixed before inspecting outcome values; no-slot trajectories remain in coverage and a sensitivity analysis.

construction.interpretation: Length-matched acknowledgement is a robustness control, not perfect semantic isolation.

deepseek_reversal.note: Point direction assessed on completed, manipulated paired subset; 24/60 DeepSeek length-matched cases remained API timeouts after one finite selective retry.

limitations: 24 LENGTH_MATCHED_ACK trajectories are missing, all for DeepSeek, after one finite selective retry; model-level DeepSeek conclusions therefore use 36/60 paired cases.
A common whitespace-token estimator controls estimated footprint uniformly across model families but is not any provider model tokenizer.
Repeated acknowledgement is semantically minimal but is not a perfect isolation of semantics from all formatting or discourse effects.
No additional control conditions were run.
Twelve completed one-turn trajectories had no intermediate assistant slot; they are retained in coverage but excluded from the primary manipulation analysis and included in a sensitivity analysis.
